v1_disposition.reason: The frozen experiment binds only the AVX2/FMA treatment and does not expose or predicate a scalar reference output.

arithmetic.input_materialization: BF16 words widened exactly by placement in the upper sixteen FP32 bits
arithmetic.scalar_reference: One explicit scalar hardware FMA per feature in ascending feature order, accumulated from +0.0f.
arithmetic.avx_treatment: Eight adjacent keys per AVX2 vector, one explicit fused multiply-add per feature in ascending feature order, accumulated from +0.0f.
arithmetic.output_materialization: One round-to-nearest-even FP32-to-BF16 conversion after the 128th FMA.
arithmetic.compiler_policy: /usr/bin/x86_64-linux-gnu-g++-15 with -O2, -mavx2, -mfma, -fno-fast-math, -fno-associative-math, -ffp-contract=off, -march=x86-64, -mtune=generic, and --build-id=none; explicit FMA intrinsics only
arithmetic.threading: single process, single thread, fixed iteration and serialization order

controls.source: Both scalar and AVX outputs equal the independently captured source probability adjoint byte-for-byte.
controls.cross_implementation: Scalar and AVX outputs are byte-identical.
controls.wrong_layout: Serialize AVX values in state, stream, head, key order and require a nonzero source mismatch count.
controls.negated: Negate dAttended before the same AVX reduction and require a nonzero source mismatch count.
controls.replay: Two complete evaluations reproduce all four outputs byte-for-byte.

execution.exclusive_host_rule: Run only after Arm B terminalizes or on separately bound hardware.
execution.result_authority: A pass proves one exact backward arithmetic edge and increments the post-dP primitive budget; it proves no integrated replay or compression gain.

activation_requirements: Every antecedent receipt and tensor matches its frozen SHA-256
The pinned compiler and linker identities are retained
All temporary output is removed after retained artifacts are materialized
A valid exclusive resource receipt accompanies execution
claim_boundary: Objective and compression credit are zero
No captured oracle tensor may ship in a Gamma codec
A pass does not prove softmax backward, value adjoints, midpoint learning, an integrated predictor, or an archive gain
